proposed_widenings.name: vehicle_object_control_platform
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is a stateful controllable vehicle/object with its own statistics, occupants, pilot requirement, persistent lever-controlled modes, and vehicle-owned attacks. None of the existing magic-item mechanics families can represent that honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because encoding this as passive, activation, composite, or spawned_creature would misrepresent a persistent vehicle/object control surface as a normal wearer ability.
